ON_TICK: Run code every in-game tick (frame), use in combination with other events to turn logic on and off in your code that runs every tick
MAIN_MENU: Run code when the main menu opens
DANGEROUS_ENVIRONMENT: Can be used to change the state of the environment, affecting music and ability to upgrade
GET_BEACON_HAZARD: If a value is returned, can be used to mark a beacon as a hazard with an icon and tooltip on the beacon map
GET_HAZARD_FLASH: Can be used to alter the opacity and color of the flash used for suns and pulsars
GET_RUN_SEED: Run code when the seed for the run is set
ON_MOUSE_L_BUTTON_DOWN: Detect left mouse button is pressed
ON_MOUSE_L_BUTTON_UP: Detect left mouse button is unpressed
ON_MOUSE_R_BUTTON_DOWN: Detect right mouse button is pressed
ON_MOUSE_R_BUTTON_UP: Detect right mouse button is unpressed
ON_MOUSE_M_BUTTON_DOWN: Detect middle mouse button is pressed
ON_MOUSE_SCROLL: Detect mouse scrolling. `direction` will be 1.0 when scrolling down, -1.0 when scrolling up.
GUI_MOUSE_MOVE: Detect mouse movement (to be used for `GenericButton`'s `MouseMove` method)
CREW_LOOP: While unpaused, run code every in-game tick for each crew member
CREW_CLONE: Called at the start of creating a `CrewMember` after the cloning process
SHIP_LOOP: While unpaused, run code every in-game tick for each ship
GET_AUGMENTATION_VALUE: Called when checking an augmentation's value
GET_DODGE_FACTOR: Can be used to alter the dodge factor for the given ship
SET_BONUS_POWER: Can be used to alter the bonus power for the given system
SELECT_ARMAMENT_PRE: Triggered when selecting a weapon to fire, can be used to alter or block the selected weapon
SELECT_ARMAMENT_POST: Triggered after selecting a weapon to fire
PROJECTILE_INITIALIZE: Called when a projectile is initialized
PROJECTILE_FIRE: Called when a projectile is fired
WEAPON_COOLDOWN_MOD: Check and possibly alter the cooldown modifier being applied to a weapon. Return value cannot be greater than 1 for non-artillery weapons.
WEAPON_STATBOX: Change the text displayed for the player weapon stats (only works if `redesignedWeaponTooltips` is enabled)
WEAPON_DESCBOX: Change the text displayed for the player weapon description
WEAPON_RENDERBOX: Change the text displayed for the player weapon cooldown timers
DRONE_COLLISION: Called when a drone collides with a projectile
DAMAGE_AREA: Called when an is about to be hit by a projectile
DAMAGE_AREA_HIT: Called when an area is hit by a projectile
DAMAGE_BEAM: Called when a beam deals damage
DAMAGE_SYSTEM: Called when a system takes damage
SYSTEM_ADD_DAMAGE: Called when damage is added to a system, occurs after all resist calculations
ACTIVATE_POWER: Called when a crew activates a power
PREPARE_POWER: Called when preparing a power activation
POWER_RESOURCE_ON_UPDATE: Called when updating a resource power
POWER_ENABLE_INIT: Called when initializing power enable state
POWER_RESOURCE_ENABLE_INIT: Called when initializing resource power enable state
POWER_READY: Called when checking if power is ready
GENERATOR_CREATE_SHIP: Called when generating a new ship from an event
GENERATOR_CREATE_SHIP_POST: Called after generating a new ship from an event
PRE_CREATE_CHOICEBOX: Called before the creation of a `ChoiceBox` by a `LocationEvent`
POST_CREATE_CHOICEBOX: Called after the creation of a `ChoiceBox` by a `LocationEvent`
TABBED_WINDOW_CONFIRM: Called for every event that closes the current tab in the upgrade menu
TABBED_WINDOW_UNDO: Called when the UNDO button is activated in the upgrade menu
JUMP_ARRIVE: Called when a ship arrives at a beacon
JUMP_LEAVE: Called when a ship leaves a beacon
ON_WAIT: Run code every time the ship waits (Spending a jump cycle without moving beacons, either when out of fuel or at last stand)
SYSTEM_BOX_MOUSE_MOVE: Called when the mouse is moved at coordinates (`x`, `y`). Coordinates are relative to the SystemBox in question.
SYSTEM_BOX_MOUSE_CLICK: Called when the mouse is clicked. `shift` indicates whether the shift key is held on click.
SYSTEM_BOX_KEY_DOWN: Called when a key is pressed. `Key` argument indicates the specific key pressed, and `shift` argument indicates whether the shift key is held on click.
GET_LEVEL_DESCRIPTION: Called to get the description of what a system does at a certain level. `systemId` indicates the ID of the system, `level` indicates the power level, and `tooltip` indicates whether the string being generated is in the context of a mouseover tooltip.
CALCULATE_LEAK_MODIFIER: Called once per ship every game tick to calculate a multiplier to the rate at which airlocks and breaches drain oxygen.
CONSTRUCT_CREWMEMBER: Called when constructing a crew member
CONSTRUCT_SPACEDRONE: Called when constructing a space drone
CONSTRUCT_SHIP_SYSTEM: Called when constructing a ship system
CONSTRUCT_SYSTEM_BOX: Called when constructing a GUI system box
